architectural_decisions.rationale: The only component that interacts directly with the presentation layer is the Api Gateway module. This is because the Api Gateway microservices design pattern is followed. This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform. The use of this pattern provides several advantages to the system, such as: It increases the security of the system by reducing the gateways to the outside, since the only way to interact with the microservices is through the Api Gateway.

The objective of these services is to form a data lake where all history is stored so that it can be processed in the analytical module. The system must be able to grow in capacity when the data volume increases. The system scales automatically as data increases.
NestJS framework is used to develop the different services. This framework allows the creation of a secure and complex REST API in an easier way than using NodeJS directly.
TypeScript is used instead of JavaScript because it is the default language for NestJS and because, thanks to its static typing, it allows for the detection of errors at compile time.
AWS is used for infrastructure. It is the set of cloud computing services that allows the creation of scalable and highly available applications.
For the data transmission to be as fast as possible, two Amazon services have been used, which allow us to perform a transmission in near real-time.
